provenance.purpose: L4 development pilot: shared raw-shot set CNN, complete-edge-mean CNN and symmetric joint pseudolikelihood on identical nested record subsets.
provenance.selection: Select model checkpoints by own-budget validation magnitude MSE only. No final-test data. Two initialization seeds are development stability checks.
provenance.information: True fields are targets/scoring references, never neural inputs or inverse-solver arguments. Raw and complete means use the same records. Mean sufficiency is an IID fixed-support statement, not a correlated-trajectory guarantee.
provenance.scope: 512/128 Hamiltonian pilot, 64/256 retained records; not directly comparable to the prior full-size 4500-record observable campaign. Inverse fit uses CPU workers; neural training requires CUDA.
provenance.long_runs: User launches research work. Ctrl+C checkpoints neural updates and finishes bounded in-flight inverse fits before returning to the menu. Source/data/device bindings prevent accidental run changes.
